issues.description: The controller method for listing all persons has differing visibility between template and solution. In the template PersonResource.getAllPersons() is declared public (typical for Spring MVC handler methods), but in the solution the same method is declared private. This visibility mismatch is unexpected for a REST endpoint and may confuse students about the required visibility for controller handler methods. It could also cause doubts whether non-public handler methods are acceptable or a mistake, and therefore constitutes an unintentional structural inconsistency between the provided starter code and the reference solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the visibility consistent and follow common Spring MVC conventions: declare getAllPersons() as public in the solution (or template) so both artifacts match. Ensure all controller handler methods remain public to avoid confusion about endpoint definitions.
